turns.question: Who was our best customer in September 2026, and how much did they spend?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no metric that ranks or names individual customers, so I can't say who the best customer was or what they spent. The closest figures are September 2026 revenue of 12,582.75 EUR (1 to 30 September 2026, non-cancelled orders) from 10 active customers. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
